description: This PHP source file defines a view for the invitees subpanel in the Meetings module of SuiteCRM. It generates a form with buttons to select contacts and users, and displays lists of invitees (users and contacts) in a tabular format using an XTemplate for rendering.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: Template rendering class used for generating HTML output for the invitees subpanel.

methods.name: get_form_header
methods.description: Helper function to generate the header for a form panel.
